scope: Corollary 6.4 (Right-topological multiplicity and parity counterexamples) of the manuscript “Ambiently homeomorphic isolated hypersurfaces of multiplicities two and three” (preprints/Ambiently-homeomorphic-isolated-hypersurfaces-of-multiplicities-two-and-three-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 059 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ce7e450c32aa20ca), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the same polynomials f1, f2 and the single finite ambient dimension N > 3 divisible by eight in Theorem 1.1, there is a homeomorphism germ φ : (CN , 0) −→ (CN , 0) such that f1 = f2 ◦ φ. Nevertheless, their multiplicities are respectively 2 and 3. Thus neither multiplicity nor multiplicity modulo two is invariant under topological right equivalence, even for reduced real-coefficient weighted homogeneous holomorphic germs with positive rational weights and isolated critical points at the origin.
